description: For an inventory, purchasing, or merchant-ops agent: forecast weekly sales and recommend a buy quantity for a specific bundle over a configurable horizon. Uses additive Holt-Winters on the bundle's stored historical sales (demand forecasting). Use this when the agent asks 'how many of bundle X should I order?', 'what should I stock for the next N weeks?', 'what's the demand outlook for bundle Y?', or 'forecast the next 8 weeks for the camera bundle'.

horizon_weeks.description: Forecast horizon in WEEKS. Default 8, range 1..52. The server converts this to days for the backend, so pass the number of weeks, not days.

name: forecast_bundle
